findings.claim_text: A governance-token takeover — not a smart-contract bug — let an attacker who spent roughly 2 ETH drain $8.5M from Term Finance's Yearn-v3-based strategy vaults on August 23, 2026, while Term's core lending markets stayed untouched.

The single most important unresolved fact in this dispute is also the simplest to state: "Tori's Ecosystem Vault" is not one product. It is a name attached to at least two structurally different things, and untangling which one — if either — had capital sitting inside the Term Finance vaults that got drained is the question Tori's "not affected" statement never actually answers.

It published on-chain forensic analysis of the April 2026 Kelp DAO/LayerZero exploit — roughly $292M — that was cited alongside independent researchers' findings in mainstream coverage of that incident [^20]. That is evidence this is not D2's first attempt at serious on-chain investigation.
findings.contradicting_quote: Not a private key exposure: 'Two RPC nodes hosted by LayerZero were compromised' feeding forged data to 'a single verifier: the LayerZero Labs DVN.'
